points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 1619年，科尔贝尔出生于法国布列塔尼地区的雷恩。他的父亲是商人，希望他继承家业，但科尔贝尔对商业和行政事务展现出浓厚兴趣。他在巴黎接受教育，学习法律和商业知识，为日后从政打下基础。这段时期，他开始接触法国宫廷政治，并展现出非凡的行政管理才能。
points.descriptionEn: Born in 1619 in Rennes, Brittany, France, Jean-Baptiste Colbert was the son of a merchant. Though his father expected him to continue the family business, Colbert showed a keen interest in commerce and administrative affairs. He received education in Paris, studying law and business knowledge, which laid the foundation for his future political career. During this period, he began to engage with French court politics and demonstrated exceptional administrative abilities.

points.title: 仕途起步
points.description: 1643年，科尔贝尔进入巴黎财政部门工作，凭借其出色的财务管理能力迅速获得赏识。他曾担任马萨林红衣主管的秘书，并在法国财政混乱时期展现出卓越的组织才能。1651年，他开始负责管理王家财产，并参与解决法国的财政危机。这一时期，他积累了丰富的行政经验，建立了广泛的人脉网络，为日后推行改革奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1643, Colbert entered the Paris financial department and quickly gained recognition for his exceptional financial management skills. He served as secretary to Cardinal Mazarin and demonstrated outstanding organizational abilities during France's financial turmoil. In 1651, he began managing royal property and participated in addressing France's financial crisis. During this period, he accumulated extensive administrative experience and built a wide network of connections, laying the foundation for his future reforms.

points.title: 财政改革
points.description: 1661年，随着马萨林的去世，科尔贝尔获得路易十四的信任，被任命为财政总监。他立即着手进行财政改革，打击贪污腐败，建立严格的会计制度，并重新组织税收系统。他创立了王家审计院，加强对财政的监督。这些措施使法国财政状况得到显著改善，为路易十四的军事扩张提供了经济基础。这一时期，科尔贝尔确立了作为法国首席财政顾问的地位。
points.descriptionEn: With Mazarin's death in 1661, Colbert gained the trust of Louis XIV and was appointed Controller-General of Finance. He immediately began implementing financial reforms, cracking down on corruption, establishing strict accounting systems, and reorganizing the tax system. He founded the Royal Audit Chamber to strengthen financial supervision. These measures significantly improved France's financial situation, providing the economic foundation for Louis XIV's military expansion. During this period, Colbert established his position as France's chief financial advisor.

points.title: 全面改革
points.description: 作为路易十四的首席顾问，科尔贝尔推行了一系列全面的经济和行政改革。他创立了东印度公司、西印度公司等商业垄断机构，促进法国海外贸易；建立王家工场，发展制造业；创办科学院和皇家舞蹈学院，推动文化艺术发展；改革海军，建立强大的法国舰队；完善道路和运河系统，改善交通。他还制定了《科尔贝尔法典》，统一了商业法规。这些改革使法国经济文化空前繁荣，奠定了法国作为欧洲强国的地位。
points.descriptionEn: As Louis XIV's chief advisor, Colbert implemented a series of comprehensive economic and administrative reforms. He established commercial monopolies such as the East India Company and West India Company to promote overseas trade; founded royal manufactories to develop industry; established the Academy of Sciences and Royal Academy of Dance to advance culture and arts; reformed the navy, building a powerful French fleet; and improved transportation systems by developing roads and canals. He also drafted the Colbert Code, unifying commercial regulations. These reforms brought unprecedented economic and cultural prosperity to France, establishing its position as a European power.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1683年9月6日，科尔贝尔在巴黎逝世。他的去世标志着法国重商主义政策的一个重要转折点。尽管他的继任者未能完全延续他的政策，但他的改革成果对法国产生了深远影响。他建立的行政体系、经济政策和工业基础持续影响法国数百年。科尔贝尔被视为现代法国行政体系的奠基人之一，他的重商主义思想影响了欧洲经济政策的发展。今天，他的名字已成为法国行政才能和国家干预经济的象征。
points.descriptionEn: On September 6, 1683, Colbert died in Paris. His death marked a significant turning point in French mercantilist policy. Although his successors did not fully continue his policies, his reforms had a profound impact on France. The administrative system, economic policies, and industrial foundation he established continued to influence France for centuries. Colbert is regarded as one of the founders of the modern French administrative system, and his mercantilist ideas influenced the development of European economic policies. Today, his name has become a symbol of French administrative prowess and state intervention in the economy.

supporter.zh: 科尔贝尔被誉为法国历史上最伟大的财政大臣之一，他通过系统性的改革使法国从财政混乱走向繁荣。他建立的重商主义政策体系为国家积累了财富，增强了法国的国际地位。他重视工业发展，创立王家工场，促进了法国制造业的崛起。同时，他推动的文化教育事业，如科学院的建立，为法国的科学文化繁荣奠定了基础。科尔贝尔的行政才能和远见使他成为路易十四时代不可或缺的支柱，他的改革精神至今仍被法国行政体系所传承。
supporter.en: Colbert is regarded as one of France's greatest finance ministers, who systematically transformed France from financial chaos to prosperity. His mercantilist policy system accumulated wealth for the nation and enhanced France's international standing. He emphasized industrial development by establishing royal manufactories, promoting the rise of French manufacturing. Meanwhile, his support for cultural and educational endeavors, such as founding the Academy of Sciences, laid the foundation for France's scientific and cultural prosperity. Colbert's administrative talent and vision made him indispensable to Louis XIV's reign, and his reform spirit continues to be inherited by the French administrative system.

critic.zh: 批评者认为科尔贝尔的政策存在严重局限性。他的重商主义政策过度强调国家干预，限制了市场自由发展；他对国内工业的保护措施导致效率低下，最终难以持续；他的财政改革虽然改善了短期状况，但未能解决根本问题，反而加重了农民负担。此外，科尔贝尔的专制管理风格和对异己的排斥，使他被视为专制制度的帮凶。他的政策虽然增强了国家实力，但也加剧了社会不平等，为法国后来的社会矛盾埋下了隐患。
critic.en: Critics argue that Colbert's policies had significant limitations. His mercantilist policies overemphasized state intervention, restricting free market development; his protectionist measures for domestic industry led to inefficiency that proved unsustainable; although his financial reforms improved the short-term situation, they failed to address fundamental issues and instead increased the burden on peasants. Furthermore, Colbert's autocratic management style and exclusion of dissenters make him seen as an accomplice to the authoritarian system. While his policies strengthened the state, they also exacerbated social inequality, sowing the seeds for future social conflicts in France.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，科尔贝尔是17世纪欧洲重商主义政策的典型代表，他的改革反映了当时欧洲国家竞争加剧的背景。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为路易十四的'大管家'，象征着法国绝对君主制的鼎盛时期。历史学界普遍认为，科尔贝尔的改革既有开创性也有局限性，他成功地将法国打造成欧洲强国，但也未能解决深层次的社会经济问题。他的行政理念对后世影响深远，成为现代国家干预经济的早期范例。科尔贝尔的一生体现了17世纪欧洲国家建设过程中的机遇与挑战。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Colbert represents the typical mercantilist policies of 17th-century Europe, and his reforms reflect the intensifying competition among European nations at the time. In popular culture, he is often depicted as Louis XIV's 'great steward,' symbolizing the zenith of French absolute monarchy. Historiography generally acknowledges that Colbert's reforms were both pioneering and limited; he successfully transformed France into a European power but failed to address deep-seated socio-economic problems. His administrative philosophy had far-reaching influence, becoming an early example of modern state intervention in the economy. Colbert's life embodies the opportunities and challenges of the European state-building process in the 17th century.

self.zh: 贸易是国家财富的源泉，而工业则是贸易的基础。
self.en: Trade is the source of national wealth, and industry is the foundation of trade.

others.zh: 科尔贝尔是法国历史上最伟大的财政大臣，他不仅挽救了濒临崩溃的法国财政，还通过系统性的改革使法国成为欧洲最强大的国家之一。
others.en: Colbert was the greatest finance minister in French history; not only did he save France's collapsing finances, but through systematic reforms he made France one of the most powerful nations in Europe.
